exposure: persistent villous atrophy (Marsh score 3) in women with celiac disease
mucosal recovery in women with celiac disease
cohort: The study included 337 women with celiac disease who gave birth to 460 infants within 5 years of a follow-up biopsy.
finding: There was no significant association between persistent villous atrophy and intrauterine growth restriction, low birth weight, preterm birth, or cesarean section compared to mucosal healing in women with celiac disease.
mod_finding: There was no significant association between persistent villous atrophy and cesarean section (OR, 0.86; 95% CI, 0.51-1.46).
